title: Qualify original zero-dependency Foundation calendar NuGet candidate with five source-free binary checks
commitMessage: test: qualify Foundation calendar NuGet candidate without publication

contribution.summary: Qualify a source-identical Foundation NuGet calendar candidate with zero dependencies and five independent package-only binary contract probes, without private-feed publication.
contribution.value: Build and pack the unchanged FoundationContract source and source csproj, verify the actual .nuspec and DLL hashes, and compile a fresh single-PackageReference consumer with exact identity, loaded SHA and provider-refusal checks.
debtChanges: The Foundation candidate is unpublished, unreserved and immutable by ID/version once its original bytes are qualified; later publication remains a distinct owner decision.
Historical Foundation source Version 0.1.0-preview.1, the single original C# source, all 541 completed native nodes and five published private packages remain unchanged.
Foundation is only a bootstrap contract, not scientific accuracy proof; public licensing, installed rollback, OS/RID claims, Decision, Discovery and AURA adoption remain out of scope.
contribution.nextAction: After a successful RS150, rehearse the immutable Foundation publisher on a disposable feed; require separate owner consent for publication of exact original candidate bytes.
